messages.content: Evening, Boss. All systems are online and running smoothly. What are we working on?
should I go watch the avengers endgame rerelease?

Endgame on the big screen is always worth it, Boss, but unless you've built a time machine to 2019, there's no official rerelease happening right now. Are you seeing showtimes somewhere, or are we feeling nostalgic?
they rereleased it as  avengers endgame encore
Ah, the Encore edition with the deleted scenes and bonus tribute footage. If it's playing near you, definitely grab a ticket, Boss. Are we planning a movie night, or checking out the runtime?
